title: Jobs
description: Your open roles. Open a job to partners and recruiters with matching candidates can refer them to you. You won't see anyone's identity until they submit.

empty.filteredDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.
empty.firstDescription: Add a role you're hiring for. Open it to partners and we'll tell you how many of their candidates fit, without revealing who they are.

new.title: New job
new.description: Paste a description to get suggested requirements, then review every field before publishing.

edit.title: Edit {title}
edit.description: Requirement changes re-run matching in the background.

detail.flashPublished: Job published. Match counts will appear in a minute.
detail.flashDraft: Draft saved. Partners can't see it until you publish.
detail.privacyNotPublished: This job isn't published, so it isn't being matched. Publish it to see how many partner candidates fit.
detail.privacyNotOpen: This job isn't open to partners. Edit it and turn on partner referrals to be matched with their candidates.
detail.privacyShort: Partner candidates stay anonymous until they're submitted.
detail.privacyShortRefreshed: Partner candidates stay anonymous until they're submitted · updated {when}
detail.submittedEmptyShort: No one yet. You'll be notified when a partner submits someone.

suggested.other: Suggested {count} skills from the text. Review before saving.
